projectFormats.policy: Unmodified legacy projects keep their version. Modulation requires explicit v9/v10 containers so older readers reject unsupported semantics. Remove no recording assets and embed no audio.

presetStorage.migration: Read prior v1 presets if v2 is absent, then save the complete current collection under v2; never write modulation into the old reader's v1 preset store

routes.order: Stable route ID order for summation
routes.range: Each route explicitly selects unipolar or bipolar normalization
routes.depth: Signed depth in the destination's declared unit
routes.targets: Existing SYNTH_PARAMETERS identifiers; static UI ranges remain distinct from bounded modulation offsets

combination.oscillatorDetune: Legacy pitch/bend/glide/vibrato base plus summed offset, bounded to +/-2400 cents before addition
combination.filterCutoff: Base frequency including legacy tone/sweep multiplied by 2^(summed octave offset bounded to +/-8); host applies its Nyquist limit

routes.normalization: New patch-v2 source normalization reserves potential oscillator level from level routes; legacy patches retain their original normalization

timing.lfo: Per-note sine phase reset at canonical note onset; rate in Hz
timing.envelope: Independent linear ADSR, same explicit note-off and legacy 2ms minimum attack/release floor contract
timing.keyTracking: clamp((MIDI pitch-root)/span,-1,1), root and span explicit
timing.smoothing: Per-route first-order recurrence y[n]=alpha*x[n]+(1-alpha)*y[n-1], alpha=1-exp(-1/(sampleRate*seconds)); reset to zero at note-on
timing.web: Actual audio-rate oscillator/constant/envelope control signals and IIR smoothing; no JavaScript per-sample arrays or timer-based parameter updates
timing.oracle: Graph control traces compared to portable mathematics at three rates: 0.02 cents pitch, 0.04 cents filter detune, 5e-6 gain/pan
timing.phase: Phase zero at the authored note-on, including the fractional interval before the first output sample in v2. Native timing does not depend on a host render quantum.
timing.browserOnset: Pitch-controlled v2 carriers silently pre-roll on a preceding boundary with an equal/opposite Fourier phase rotation. Recipe normalization stays fixed; source gains are muted until the authored note-on. See docs/native-onset-investigation.json.

automationAlignment.basePrecedence: Future SYN-010 automation updates the base value of these same parameter IDs before modulation is combined
notImplemented: Beat/Song/game override recording and precedence persistence

native.profile: Native C++ execution-plan v1/v2, all four canonical sources and six target IDs with up to 16 routes; unsupported noise/drive/delay/filter-sweep/legacy LFO paths reject explicitly
native.future: Evaluate these same bounded source/range/depth/smoothing/combination semantics in a native callback without parsing JSON or allocating per block

usability.basicControls: Cutoff, attack, release and volume remain unchanged and directly reachable
usability.advanced: One optional movement-routes section; amount/speed first, source/target/range available contextually

limitations: Full native DSP support is pending
Device performance with maximum route counts is unqualified
Musical polish and newcomer comprehension need human observation
Worker startup for 32/64 voices with 16 routes took about 3/6 seconds. Stress capture suspends the audio clock during preparation; it does not qualify interactive scheduling.

gameCompatibility.policy: Preserve patch v1/v2, Beat v7/v9, Song v8/v10. Never silently downgrade modulation for old game readers or require bounced WAV as the native music format.
